snippet.title: Peer-2-Pizza - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4484490/Peer2Pizza/

The future of pizza delivery is here: deliver pizza through the power of the internet today! And when delivering, time moves when you move. So jump, dash, and dive your way through a network of obstacles and challenges, reach the customer, and do one very important job: deliver the pizza.

#gaming #indiegame #indiedev
